proves.claim: A prepared event committed by commitPrepared is the row logEvent writes: the next event_id and the same time, author, kind, item and detail, including the seat model.

store.io-board-write-event.same-row-as-l.why: The prepared form must keep logEvent's row semantics so the move migrations can swap one for the other without changing history.

proves.claim: An engine-gated event kind is refused while building, as logEvent refuses it, and a failed commit of a prepared event appends no event.

store.io-board-write-event.refuses-befor.why: A refused or failed append must leave the event log untouched, because the build reads and refuses before any transaction opens.
